name: Leak in the distribution network
summary: Air escapes from the pipework, hoses or couplings behind the reservoirs, so the unit has to replace what the plant loses.
signal_moves_text: How fast line pressure falls while the unit is not delivering is gradually faster.
checks: Stop the unit, close the isolation valve at the pneumatic panel and watch whether the reservoir pressure still falls.
remedy: Seal or replace the leaking joints, hoses and couplings, then repeat the pressure-hold test.
